title: PostgreSQL type-confusion primitive chained into RCE in CVE-2026-6460
summary: A new technical write-up describes CVE-2026-6460, tracing a PostgreSQL type-confusion primitive back 22 years and walking through an exploit chain that turns it into remote code execution. The author presents exploit-development research rather than a vendor advisory, so the RCE claim rests on the write-up&\#x27;s chain. The main dispute in discussion is whether "RCE" is the right label: commenters argue the starting point appears to be an authenticated SQL or database account, making it privilege escalation in practice.
